mcpServers.approval.no: Not approved, or the program or a file it is given changed since. It asks you again before it runs.
mcpServers.approval.revoked: Approval withdrawn. Nothing runs until you approve it again.
mcpServers.approval.yes: Approved: this exact program and these arguments may run.
mcpServers.ask.none: No MCP server is on. Add one in Settings → MCP servers.
mcpServers.ask.prompt: What should the agent do with your MCP servers' tools?
mcpServers.ask.title: Ask with my MCP servers
mcpServers.call.description: What the server says the tool does
mcpServers.call.title: Allow “{tool}” on “{server}”?
mcpServers.call.why.ask: This tool asks before each call.
mcpServers.call.why.changed: The server changed this tool since you approved it. Read what it says now before you allow it.
mcpServers.call.why.new: You have not approved this tool yet.
mcpServers.desktopOnly: This server is a program: it runs only in the desktop app.
mcpServers.elicit.review: Check and change your answers before you send them.
mcpServers.elicit.secret: The server asks for a secret ({fields}) in a form. MCP servers must not do that, so Lumen will not send it. Decline, or cancel.
mcpServers.elicit.title: The MCP server “{server}” asks for your input
mcpServers.elicit.urlIntro: It wants you to open this page. Lumen has not opened or loaded it.
mcpServers.elicit.urlOutside: It opens in your browser, outside Lumen: neither Lumen nor the AI can see the page or what you type there.
mcpServers.elicit.warn.ip-address: The address is a bare IP address, not a site name.
mcpServers.elicit.warn.long-host: The address has an unusually long host name.
mcpServers.elicit.warn.mixed-script: The address mixes alphabets: it may imitate another site's name.
mcpServers.elicit.warn.not-https: The address is not https: what you send there is not encrypted.
mcpServers.elicit.warn.punycode: The address uses Punycode (xn--): it may imitate another site's name.
mcpServers.elicit.warn.userinfo: The address has a user name in it (user@host): the real site is after the @.
mcpServers.form.error.id: The id is lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
mcpServers.form.error.label: Give the server a name.
mcpServers.form.error.npx: npx -y downloads and runs a package without asking. Install the server and name its program.
mcpServers.form.error.taken: A server with this id is already in the list.
mcpServers.form.error.url: Use an https address, or http only on this computer.
mcpServers.form.label: Name
mcpServers.form.stdioNote: The first time it runs, the desktop app shows the exact command and asks you to allow it.
mcpServers.form.stdioPinned: The approval is for that exact program file (its full path and sha256), those exact arguments and that folder, and for every file an argument names. If one byte of them changes, or the arguments change, nothing runs until you approve again.
mcpServers.intro: Outside MCP servers give the local agents more tools. A server is off until you turn it on. Lumen asks before a tool runs the first time, and again whenever a server changes a tool.
mcpServers.licenseUnverified: Licence not checked: read it before you add it
mcpServers.none: No servers yet. Add one below, or pick a suggested one.
mcpServers.offline: This program makes no network requests (otherwise airplane mode blocks it)
mcpServers.reaches.files: Reads and writes the folders you give it
mcpServers.stdio.changed: Not started: the program, or a file it is given, changed since you approved it. Approve it again to run it.
mcpServers.stdio.notApproved: Not started: this exact command is not approved. Lumen runs a program only after you approve its full path, its sha256 and its arguments.
mcpServers.suggestedNote: Use fills the form. Nothing connects or runs until you add the server and turn it on.
